whatThisLaneDid: Opted the five Vermont sealing families that share scripts/build-census-v1-vt_seal_misdemeanor-set.mjs into suppressSynthesizedAppearances, the default-off option FIX50 built into the shared sanitizer and proved on the sibling vt_seal_nonconviction-set. One option, one call site, no change to any shared module, field map, write or text. Each family's fixtures were confirmed against VF08's recorded digests first, rebuilt twice byte-identically, and read pixel-for-pixel at every widget rect VF08 counted.
grantsNothing: A repaired packet is review evidence. It authorizes no fulfillment, opens no commercial route and promotes nothing.

obligationsThisRowDoesNotDischarge: CENTRAL RASTER on the new bytes. The RASTER_PASS receipt this family stands on is bound to the digests recorded under digests.before, which this rebuild supersedes; it stops binding and a fresh central raster is owed. RASTER_QUEUE.json and MASTER_QUEUE.json were read and never opened for writing, and the local 150 dpi rasters recorded here are measurement in this container only and were deleted.

INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION. This lane edited the builder, rebuilt these bytes and measured them, so it verifies none of them. No verdict was written or replaced, product-wiring.json was not edited, binding.acceptanceReceipt is null and no obligation is scored here.

PRE-EXISTING DIRECTORY DRIFT CARRIED IN BY THE REBUILD, which this lane neither authored nor repairs. The committed directory was behind the shared host at base 760c6285d, and a rebuild with the option OFF already reproduces this drift: proved by stashing this lane's single edit, rebuilding vt_seal_misdemeanor-set at base and diffing. For this family it is one rewritten line of participant-instructions.md, step 4 on the fee waiver. It is a markdown file that no appearance option can reach; the delivered PDF pages carry none of it.

THE COHORT. FIX50's read-only scan counts 47 families exposed to the same shared behaviour. Five of them are opted in here and the rest are untouched, unmeasured and unrepaired by this lane; the option stays default-off precisely so that naming a family changes nothing about its bytes.

THE FOUR CASES THE OPTION DELIBERATELY LEAVES ALONE, as FIX50 recorded them: a widget that ships its own appearance for its current state (600-00228's six, measured unchanged below), a widget with no /AS, a widget whose /AP /N is a bare stream, and any widget of a field this run wrote.

rows.grantConfirmed: node scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/claim.mjs --assert FIX58 vt_seal_18_to_21-set -> CLAIM_OK FIX58 vt_seal_18_to_21-set (repair, grant set e65ade4647fc32cb), exit 0. All five asserted before the builder was edited or any fixture rebuilt.

fixtureIdentityBeforeAnyChange.source: data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/vf08/rows.json and vf08/COHORT_MEASUREMENT.json, both of which record the same pair for this family

whatChanged.theEdit: One option, in one place: suppressSynthesizedAppearances: true added to the single finalizeOfficialForm call in renderDocument() in scripts/build-census-v1-vt_seal_misdemeanor-set.mjs, beside evaluateDeclaredMinimumSize, with a comment naming the measurement. That host is imported by all five builders, so the one option opts in exactly these five families and nothing else.
whatChanged.whatWasNotEdited: No shared module. rcap-active-content.mjs and rcap-official-form-finalize.mjs are untouched: FIX50 already built the function and the default-off option and this lane only passes it. No field map, no census row, no policy, no fact, no fixture definition, no instruction generator, no route mark and no text was edited. The four sibling builder shims are unchanged.
whatChanged.theDefect: 200-00130 ships 12 check-box widgets and 200-00132 ships 2, and every one of the 14 is at /AS /Off with /Yes as the only state in /AP /N. sanitizeAndFlatten calls updateFieldAppearances() before flatten(); pdf-lib regenerates an appearance for exactly that condition and its default provider paints a stroked square, which flatten() then stamps on the page. Under ISO 32000-1 12.5.5 a conforming viewer paints nothing where /AS names no stream, so the square is ink the court's paper does not print. Read from the pinned binaries in this container by content hash, the 20 selection widgets across the three bound forms split 12 + 2 exposed and 6 shipping their own /Off, which is the 14 + 6 VF08 counted.
whatChanged.theRemedy: The option installs an empty form XObject for the missing state, so pdf-lib reports no update is needed, synthesizes nothing, and flattens a stream that paints nothing. It supplies the state the source omitted rather than suppressing a drawing.

rebuild.runTwice: The whole family directory was copied aside after the first build and compared with diff -r against the second. Zero differences across every file: the rebuild is deterministic.

digests.pageCountUnchanged: 6 -> 6 in both fixtures. Nothing was added to or removed from the packet.
digests.whyTheFilesGotSmaller: An empty appearance stream replaces a generated one carrying a rectangle path, a stroke and a graphics-state block, so each of the 14 widgets costs fewer bytes than the square it replaces.

perWidgetMeasurement.method: Both committed fixtures and both rebuilt fixtures rastered locally with pdftoppm at 150 dpi, greyscale, pages 1-6, into /tmp. The three pinned source binaries were resolved by SHA-256 and rastered at the same settings. Every selection widget's own /Rect was read from the pinned binaries with pdf-lib and mapped to its delivered packet page (200-00130 -> pages 1-2, 200-00132 -> 3-4, 600-00228 -> 5-6, which the 6-page packet and the 2+2+2 source page counts fix). Dark pixels (grey < 128) were counted inside each rect on the source page, the delivered page before and the delivered page after. Rasters deleted after measuring.

changedPixelsOutsideEverySelectionWidget.note: Rects dilated by 3 px because pdf-lib strokes the synthesized border centred on the rect edge, so half its width falls just outside. Zero pixels moved anywhere else on any of the six pages of either fixture.

perWidgetMeasurement.routeElectionMark: None to preserve. This host marks no checkbox on the participant's behalf: every selection widget on 200-00130 and 200-00132 is policy 'election' or 'protect' and is left to the participant or the prosecutor, which is why all 14 rects now read exactly the pinned form's own ink with nothing added. The sibling vt_seal_nonconviction-set's route-election diagonals have no counterpart here.
perWidgetMeasurement.everyParticipantWriteUnchanged: pdftotext -layout over all 6 pages of both fixtures is CHARACTER-IDENTICAL before and after, and reports/actual-writes.json is byte-identical. Not one write moved, changed size or changed value.
